crates.name: libc
crates.safetyPhilosophy: 100% unsafe C ABI declarations matching platform libc headers verbatim.
crates.posixCoverage: Comprehensive coverage of POSIX.1-2008 / POSIX.1-2024 symbols and GNU libc extensions across Linux, macOS, BSD, Illumos, Windows MSVC/GNU.

crates.name: nix
crates.role: Idiomatic safe POSIX / UNIX Rust bindings
crates.safetyPhilosophy: Safe Rust wrappers converting raw pointers to slices/references and errno return codes to Result<T, nix::errno::Errno>.
crates.posixCoverage: Extensive modules covering unistd, fcntl, sys::socket, sys::signal, sys::termios, sys::wait, sys::stat, sys::mman.

crates.name: rustix
crates.safetyPhilosophy: Bypasses C runtime on Linux/Android by default using safe inline assembly system calls; wraps libc on BSD/macOS. Zero-cost file descriptor lifecycles via BorrowedFd and OwnedFd.
crates.posixCoverage: Subsystems: rustix::fs, rustix::io, rustix::net, rustix::process, rustix::thread, rustix::termios, rustix::event, rustix::mm.

crates.name: uutils-coreutils
crates.safetyPhilosophy: Memory-safe Rust CLI implementations matching GNU CLI flags, environment variables (POSIXLY_CORRECT), and edge-case behavior.
crates.posixCoverage: 100+ utilities implementing both POSIX Utility Conventions and GNU coreutils extensions with 99%+ test suite parity.
